title: Recipe preview GPU witness needs an automatic pipeline-cache prewarm
body: The queued normal gate cx-readyfence2:gpu-normal-10-after-render-pause-revert timed out at recipe serial 18 with publishedSerial 16 after all six shader bundles completed; rerunning the same gate with the runtime cache left by that attempt passed all 10 serial-tied readbacks (serials 8 through 26). This is tier luna, effort:M: appflow_channel_gate.py should provision or prewarm the worker pipeline cache, or report the cache-warm phase before its bounded 60-second wait, so a manual retry is not required.
